title: Same Flows, Opposite Verdicts: Feature Reconstruction in Cross-Dataset Intrusion Detection
description: Camera-ready research artifact for IEEE RIVF 2026 paper #1571348135. A specified reconstruction of two MachineLearningCVE-absent fields reverses the sign of InSDN-trained logistic regression on row-matched CICIDS2017 flows. Federated averaging is the evaluation setting, not the identified cause. No IEEE Xplore DOI is claimed.
